# @surfaces-ui/data

DataSource interface, Arrow result helpers and an in-memory source.

The interfaces every component uses (`DataSource`, `Discovery`, `Pipelines`, `Semantics`, `StateStorage`), Arrow helpers, the plain filter form, and in-memory implementations for tests and demos. Implement `DataSource` to put the components on your own backend; nothing else is needed.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/data
```

## Use

```tsx
import { collect, memoryDataSource } from "@surfaces-ui/data";

const data = memoryDataSource({ tables: { orders: [{ region: "EU", amount: 120 }] } });
const result = await collect(data.execute({ sourceId: "memory", query: { baseSql: "SELECT * FROM orders" } }));
result.table; // an Arrow table
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.

Every Surfaces UI package is released at the same version; install them all at that one version, since mixing releases is not supported.
